current_winner_matched_comparison.uncertainty: Not estimated in this pair audit; three week clusters are limited support.

limitations: The inherited current replay covers 132 of 183 completed regular games; the market-assisted matched comparison covers 128.
The current new frontier ablations use 139 available games and cannot be merged with the 132-game or 128-game scoreboards.
The leading residual head has no scored predictions for the 47 completed games in the latest seven-day window.
Historical selected champions are prospective shadow candidates, not proven current-season market winners.
Preserved CatBoost and margin ensemble current historical states remain unavailable for exact historical comparison.
No automatic promotions; original-issued, replay and later-fitted evidence remain separate.
